=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text tstart "tH.........|.   .      |   ...     |.   .      |Ht.. ......"
text tgen "generation "
global cur uchar 55
global nxt uchar 55
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emitb writes the single byte c
fn emitb c ulong to void
d = new uchar 1 0
put d 0 uchar c
emit d
end
note the 5 x 11 board from the task: H electron head, t tail, . conductor, space empty; a head becomes a
note tail, a tail a conductor, and a conductor a head when 1 or 2 of its 8 neighbours are heads
fn heads r long c long to ulong
n = ulong 0
for a ulong 3
for b ulong 3
y = sub add r long a 1
x = sub add c long b 1
if and and ge y 0 lt y 5 and ge x 0 lt x 11
if eq get cur add mul ulong y 11 ulong x 72
n = add n 1
end
end
end
end
ret n
end
fn rule k ulong n ulong to uchar
v = get cur k
if eq v 72
ret 116
end
if eq v 116
ret 46
end
if and eq v 46 or eq n 1 eq n 2
ret 72
end
ret v
end
fn step to void
for r ulong 5
for c ulong 11
k = add mul r 11 c
put nxt k rule k heads long r long c
end
end
for i ulong 55
put cur i get nxt i
end
end
fn main to int
for r ulong 5
for c ulong 11
put cur add mul r 11 c get tstart add mul r 12 c
end
end
for g ulong 10
emit tgen
emitu g
emit nl
for i ulong 55
emitb ulong get cur i
if eq rem i 11 10
emit nl
end
end
step
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
